auth.type: Label of the picker that chooses the authentication type (None, Basic, Bearer token, and so on).
auth.username: Label of the user name field of Basic authentication.
auth.password: Label of the password field of Basic authentication.
auth.token: Label of the field for a bearer token.
auth.key: Label of the field for the name of an API key (a header or query parameter name).
auth.value: Label of the field for the value of an API key.
auth.addTo: Label of the picker that chooses where an API key is added: the request headers or the query string.
auth.inHeader: Option of the Add to picker: send the API key as a request header. Keep Header.
auth.inQuery: Option of the Add to picker: send the API key as a query string parameter.
auth.fieldsNote: {{example}} is the variable syntax of Gostman with the word variables inside double braces. Keep it as given.
auth.showValue: Accessible label of the eye button that shows a hidden secret.
auth.hideValue: Accessible label of the eye button that hides a secret again.
auth.methods.bearer: Option of the authentication type picker. Bearer is the HTTP scheme name and stays in English.
auth.methods.apiKey: Option of the authentication type picker.
